Help

Routing rules

Only horizontal and vertical segments are allowed.
Connections exit perpendicular to block edges.
Drag square handles, Move the entire segment.
Arbitrary diagonal corners are not supported.

Instructions

Double-click a segment to insert an orthogonal detour. Red lines indicate routing collisions with blocks, The original route is restored on release.

Shift+ Drag ports along the block edge. Drag a port normally to create a connection. In Add Port mode, Click a block edge.

Crossing lines are not connected. Only solid circles represent shared junctions. Drag from a hollow corner handle to create a branch; Ports can also connect to existing junctions.

Both workspaces are saved independently. Current, Voltage is a manual annotation, No automatic calculation or validation. This tool does not simulate circuits, Does not check component or cable ratings. Matching labels do not connect automatically.

Templates

Each workspace includes an editable example. From “Templates” button reloads the current workspace, The other workspace is not affected; Undo available. Example part numbers and values are not actual IC Specifications.

Auto layout

Arrange by connection sources and destinations, Supports left to right, Top to bottom. Cycles are treated as one group, Junctions are arranged together. Clears manual detours, Recalculate orthogonal routes; Can be undone. Auto layout uses a heuristic, Minimum crossings are not guaranteed.

Input / Output port

Select block, Set input in the inspector, output enabled state and top / Middle / bottom position. Default left input is at the top, right output in the middle; Loads may disable output. Only one selected port is shown per side, Hidden after connecting. Disabling connected ports requires confirmation, Remove connected lines after confirmation, Undo available. Legacy ports are merged into input / output ports while preserving connections.

Compact and align

Set block width in the inspector, or press “Fit to content” Remove old heights and excess widths. Small port markers retain a generous click target. “Align” Align left and right ports using a reference block, or the top, Centerline, Left edge or width alignment. Set arrow size after selecting a connection, Units are diagram px. Top left ☰ Collapse Project Explorer.

Presentation design

“Layout and typography” Set Chinese and Latin fonts and sizes for this workspace. Select a block to change its fill, Border, Accent line and text color, and adjust individually IC Part number size. White text is selected automatically on dark backgrounds.

Screen reading

Export defaults 1600×900, 1×, Center the complete design with padding. Readability is estimated at 1366 px Estimated scaled size on a wide display IC and label sizes; Large diagrams trigger a warning, Higher resolution alone does not improve readability. Use compact layout, Shorten names or split into multiple designs.

Image export

PNG Supports 1× / 2× / 3× and transparent backgrounds; SVG is a scalable vector image. Export the complete design, Excludes the editing interface. Empty diagrams cannot be exported as images.

Block annotations

After selecting a block, Enable voltage in the inspector, Current, Power and efficiency. Shown when no value is entered —. Unchecking only hides the annotation, Values are not cleared. Blocks do not have a notes field. Add a workspace heading from the toolbar.

Line colors

After selecting a connection, Choose a preset or custom color. Red is reserved for routing collision warnings; Selection is indicated by an outline, Custom connection colors are preserved.
